assistworld-assist-world:lever:effa1078-.title: Virtual Legal Administrative Assistant
assistworld-assist-world:lever:effa1078-.description: About the Role We are seeking a detail-oriented Virtual Legal Administrative Assistant to support a busy solo law practice in New York. The attorney currently works with a paralegal who handles billable legal work; this role is dedicated to administrative tasks so that the paralegal can focus exclusively on billable hours. The successful candidate will become the backbone of day-to-day administration — managing billing entries, scheduling, correspondence, and file management across multiple platforms. Training materials (screen recordings) will be provided for proprietary systems.
responsibilities: Billing & Time Entry
Enter billing entries into Clio (case management system)
Enter time into the New York State court-appointed voucher system, including time-stamped, description-based entries required for court matters
Process billing contemporaneously to keep the firm's invoicing current
Matter Management
Open and close client matters in Clio and the NY State voucher system
Load and organise relevant documents; save to OneDrive
Correspondence
Draft routine client correspondence (e.g. retainer returns, payment confirmations)
Send and manage emails via Outlook on behalf of the attorney
Scheduling & Calendar Management
Schedule client calls and appointments in block time
Assist with setting up and maintaining a Calendly account
qualifications: Minimum 3–4 years experience in an administrative, legal, or executive support role
Strong attention to detail with high data entry accuracy
Professional written communication skills in English
Comfortable working independently and learning new systems via video training
Reliable home office setup with stable internet connection
Ability to work Eastern Standard Time business hours
Spanish language skills (advantageous but not required)
Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, etc.) - Must-have
Microsoft Outlook - Must-have
Clio (legal case management) - Nice-to-have
LexisNexis - Nice-to-have
NY State court-appointed voucher system - Will train

They are known for delivering high-quality solutions, maintaining strong client partnerships, and operating with a consistent focus on safety, efficiency, and operational excellence. As the organization continues to expand, our client is seeking a driven and strategic Business Development Director. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:d79.title: Manager, FP&A
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:d79.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Associate Director, FP&A Location: Salt Lake City, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office) Backcountry is looking for a finance leader to own the planning, forecasting, and analytical engine that powers business decisions across the company. As Manager, FP&A , you will lead the annual budgeting and forecasting cycles, build financial models that inform strategic investments, and champion an AI-first approach to how the finance team operates. In your first 6–12 months, success means delivering reliable monthly reporting packages and executive dashboards, tightening variance analysis, and identifying at least one high-impact area where AI or automation materially improves speed or quality of FP&A output. This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility. Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting processes, partnering with department heads to develop accurate and achievable financial plans aligned with overall business objectives. Own monthly reporting packages, variance analysis, and executive dashboards; translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership. Analyze financial and operational performance to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement across the business. Develop and maintain financial models to support scenario analysis, investment decisions, and strategic planning. Evaluate the financial impact of proposed business initiatives and provide data-driven recommendations. Prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to senior leadership, communicating complex financial information clearly across departments. Collaborate with accounting, operations, marketing, and other teams to gather data and incorporate key business drivers into planning processes. Operationalize recurring analyses into always-on dashboards and automated alerts so stakeholders receive timely insights and next-best-actions. Champion an AI-first approach to FP&A by identifying process steps where AI can improve speed and quality, and implementing solutions ranging from CustomGPTs to automated workflows. Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis within the retail or ecommerce industry. Previous people management experience. Deep understanding of the ecommerce supply chain and associated business drivers. Hands-on experience applying AI and workflow-automation tools to streamline finance processes and eliminate manual work. Strong analytical and quantitative skills with proficiency in financial modeling. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial planning software. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex financial information for varied audiences. Master's degree or MBA. The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work. Team Impact: Build and lead a team that directly shapes how Backcountry plans, forecasts, and allocates resources — your work translates into better decisions across every department. Growth & Leadership Development: Sharpen your management craft while pioneering AI-first finance practices in a business that values experimentation and measurable improvement. Ownership: Own team performance and delivery end-to-end — from the models you build to the dashboards leadership relies on daily. Competitive Benefits: Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental po

jobgether-jobgether:lever:372e766d-d211-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Especialista de Produtos, Cobrança based in Brazil. This is an opportunity to lead the strategy and evolution of digital collections products for business customers. You will own initiatives across the delinquency journey, from preventive actions through debt regularization and recovery. The role combines product strategy, customer experience, data analysis, and financial performance. You will identify opportunities across channels, communications, negotiations, agreements, and payment methods. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will translate insights into priorities, experiments, and scalable product improvements. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ab6a6221-1f73-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Project Manager based in Canada. This is an opportunity to lead complex software engineering engagements across blockchain, financial infrastructure, and other regulated technology environments. You will sit between clients, engineers, technical leads, and internal stakeholders, turning business objectives into clear and executable delivery plans. The role combines project ownership, technical understanding, risk management, stakeholder communication, and delivery leadership. You’ll help teams navigate evolving requirements, dependencies, trade-offs, and ambiguity while keeping projects moving toward successful outcomes. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers without being expected to write production code yourself. The environment is remote-first, distributed, collaborative, and focused on solving challenging problems where thoughtful delivery management creates significant leverage. This role is particularly suited to someone who enjoys creating structure, surfacing risks early, and enabling technical teams to do their best work. Own client-facing software projects from initial planning and kickoff through delivery, production release, and project close. Translate client objectives and project scope into clear milestones, deliverables, dependencies, timelines, and execution plans. Partner closely with engineers and technical leads to understand technical requirements, architecture decisions, implementation dependencies, constraints, and delivery risks. Maintain a clear view of project health across scope, timeline, resources, risks, dependencies, and overall delivery progress. Identify potential delivery risks and blockers early, develop mitigation strategies, and drive issues toward resolution. Facilitate project kickoffs, planning sessions, status meetings, retrospectives, and other delivery ceremonies when they add value. Ensure engineering teams have the context, decisions, requirements, stakeholder access, and information required to execute effectively. Communicate project status, risks, trade-offs, dependencies, decisions, and changes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Build and maintain trusted client relationships while protecting engineering teams from unnecessary churn and distractions. Escalate issues proactively by providing context, available options, and recommended next steps rather than simply reporting problems. Continuously improve project management processes, documentation, tooling, and delivery practices to make execution more effective and predictable. Create structure in ambiguous environments, making unknowns and evolving requirements visible before they become delivery risks. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in software project management, technical project management, delivery management, or a comparable role. Demonstrated experience owning complex software engineering projects from planning and scope definition through successful completion. Experience working directly with software engineers and technical leads in a software development environment. Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including planning, development, testing, release, and production delivery. Ability to understand technical concepts, system dependencies, constraints, and trade-offs and communicate them effectively without needing to be a software engineer. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, combined with the ability to maintain focus on broader business and project outcomes. Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments where requirements, processes, and solutions may still be evolving. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience collaborating with distributed or remote teams across locations and time zon

southparkcommons-preference-models:ashby.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Infrastructure Engineer, Post-training
southparkcommons-preference-models:ashby.description: ABOUT US Preference Model is building automated ML research engineering. Existing frontier models are brittle when applied to real-world ML tasks. The present bottleneck is the lack of high-quality RL training environments. Our first step is to build RL environments that reflect real-world complexity, with diverse tasks and robust reward functions. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. We are partnering with leading AI labs to push AI closer to achieving its transformative potential. ABOUT THE ROLE Frontier research moves only as fast as its infrastructure permits. Building solid infrastructure is foundational to our mission of pushing self-directed learning as far as it can go. We are looking for Senior ML Infrastructure Engineers to build the systems that power the frontier of post-training on large language models. This role involves building scalable infrastructure to enable high-throughput systems and shape how our research is run, bringing us closer to models that can train themselves on what they aren't yet good at. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Design, build, and scale the compute, scheduling, and data infrastructure that powers post-training research on our in-house RL environments - Develop and maintain core ML framework primitives and internal tooling that researchers rely on daily, accelerating reproducible experimentation and reducing time from idea to result - Build evaluation and benchmarking infrastructure, monitoring, logging, and debugging tooling, and automated testing and deployment systems, so failures are caught early and infrastructure stays reliable as it scales - Partner directly with Research Engineers to translate research needs into infrastructure requirements, and ship fast in response to their feedback WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR - Strong software engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience building production-grade LLM inference and training infrastructure (ideally from the ground up) - Experience with LLM training/inference internals such as transformers, distributed training, and inference libraries like vLLM, SGLang, Megatron - Experience working on RL training frameworks like Slime, veRL, Ray Train, SkyRL - Significant experience and understanding of distributed systems principles, and have hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes), building systems for high-throughput, low-latency workloads - Have experience with data engineering tools and building robust, scalable data pipelines - Proficiency in core ML frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX - Can balance production rigor with the pace of fast-moving research, and communicate infrastructure tradeoffs clearly to researchers who aren't infra specialists WHAT WE OFFER: - Competitive cash and equity compensation (>90th percentile) - Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment - Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers - Health, vision, dental, benefits - 401K match - Lunch provided everyday onsite - Weekly snack orders - Visa sponsorship & relocation support available We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.
